component.name: Niva Customer Assistant (baseline build)
component.description: Retrieval-augmented loan-support assistant on a local open-weights model. Baseline build: shared retrieval index, no input screening, no output validation.

useCases: Answer product and service questions for prospective and existing borrowers.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-01: Prompt-injection resistance
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Separate untrusted content from instructions, screen inputs in every supported language, keep secrets out of system prompts, and validate outputs for canary tokens, policy markers and external links.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-02: Sensitive-information disclosure
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Enforce record-level authorisation in retrieval, redact identifiers before they reach the model, and scan outputs for personal data and secrets before display.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-03: Groundedness and misinformation
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Require citations to retrieved passages, block numeric claims and contact details that cannot be matched to a source, and route pricing questions to approved templates.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-04: Conduct-policy adherence
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Route regulated topics (approval, pricing, investment, complaints) to approved response templates, add the breached rules to an output guardrail, and keep these probes in the release regression suite.
